taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA -- sky130 1.8 V MOS devices plus ideal R/C only.
*
* Main path : NMOS-LVT input pair M1A/M1B (cascoded by M1CA/M1CB, gates tied to vdd) folds into
*             PMOS sources M5A/M5B -> PMOS cascodes M6A/M6B.  NMOS cascodes M4A/M4B over the
*             wide-swing mirror M3A/M3B (diode through M4A at node x) give the single-ended output.
* Aux pair  : PMOS-LVT pair M2A/M2B injects at na/nb to extend the follower range to low CM.
* Boosters  : A_n (NB*) drives M4B gate g4b so nb tracks low-pass-filtered na;
*             A_p (PB*) drives M6B gate g6b so pb tracks low-pass-filtered pa.  Each booster is an
*             NMOS-input folded cascode behind source-follower level shifters; A_p reaches the low
*             gate voltage of M6B through the output follower PSF.  Equal Vds on both sides of the
*             folded stage keeps the systematic offset in the microvolt range.
* Bias      : every current is mirrored from the 50 uA iref input; cascode gate biases come from
*             replica diodes with series resistors (vcp, vcn, vcpb); nlo/pbl are low-current-density
*             mirror references for sinks/sources that operate close to the rails.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- bias generation (iref mirror, pmos reference pb0, cascode replicas vcp/vcn)
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=6
XMB1 pb0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=50 nf=6
XMP0 pb0 pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=6
RCP vdd qcp 3.2e+04
XMBC vcp vcp qcp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=7 nf=1
XMBCS vcp nlo vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=10
XMBNS vcn pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XMBN vcn vcn qcn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=3.5 nf=1
RCN qcn vss 3.2e+04
* ---- main folded-cascode core
XM0 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=38
XM1A d1a vinp tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=12
XM1B d1b vinn tail tail sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=12
XM1CA pa vdd d1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=26.2 nf=3
XM1CB pb vdd d1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=26.2 nf=3
XM5A pa pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=250 nf=31
XM5B pb pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=250 nf=31
XM6A x vcp pa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=70 nf=9
XM6B vout g6b pb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=70 nf=9
XM4A x vcn na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=35 nf=4
XM4B vout g4b nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=35 nf=4
XM3A na x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28.8 nf=4
XM3B nb x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28.8 nf=4
* ---- auxiliary PMOS input pair (low input common-mode range)
XMAT atail pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=4
XM2A na vinp atail atail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=4
XM2B nb vinn atail atail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30 nf=4
* ---- bias-node bypass and output load-sharing capacitor
CBYP1 vcp vdd 2e-12
CBYP2 vcn vss 2e-12
COUT vout vss 4e-13
* ---- booster references (low-pass filtered left-side fold nodes) and booster bias
RFP pa pref 1e+06
CFP pref vdd 1e-12
RFN na nref 1e+06
CFN nref vss 1e-12
RBC vdd qcb 6e+04
XBCP vcpb vcpb qcb qcb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=2
XBCS vcpb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=5 nf=1
CBC vcpb vdd 1p
XBPLS pbl iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XBPL pbl pbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=100 nf=12
XBLS nlo pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
XBLO nlo nlo vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=80 nf=10
* ---- booster A_n: pmos source-follower shift-up, nmos-input folded cascode -> g4b
XNSA vss nref snr snr sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XNSB vss nb snb snb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XNSAS snr pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XNSBS snb pb0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XNBT nbt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=2
XNB1A nbfa snr nbt nbt sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=2
XNB1B nbfb snb nbt nbt sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=2
XNB3A nbfa pbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=25
XNB3B nbfb pbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=25
XNB4A nbta vcpb nbfa nbfa sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=5
XNB4B g4b vcpb nbfb nbfb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=5
XNB5A nbsa nbda vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=5
XNB5B nbsb nbda vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=5
XNB6A nbda nbta nbsa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=2
XNB6B g4b nbta nbsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=2
RNBM nbta nbda 3.5e+04
CNB g4b vss 2e-12
* ---- booster A_p: nmos source-follower shift-down, folded cascode, output follower -> g6b
XPSA vdd pref spr spr sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XPSB vdd pb spb spb sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XPSAS spr iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XPSBS spb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=8 nf=1
XPBT pbt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=2
XPB1A pbfa spr pbt pbt sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=2
XPB1B pbfb spb pbt pbt sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=20 nf=2
XPB3A pbfa pbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=25
XPB3B pbfb pbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=25
XPB4A pbta vcpb pbfa pbfa sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=5
XPB4B bo vcpb pbfb pbfb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=5
XPB5A pbsa pbda vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=5
XPB5B pbsb pbda vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=5
XPB6A pbda pbta pbsa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=2
XPB6B bo pbta pbsb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=2
RPBM pbta pbda 3.5e+04
CPB bo vss 2e-12
XPSF vdd bo g6b g6b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XPSFS g6b nlo vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=20
.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted complementary-input folded-cascode OTA (Sky130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C)
*
* Signal path: NMOS-lvt main pair (cascoded to VDD) folds into the top PMOS
* sources (ft1/ft2); a smaller PMOS-lvt pair folds into the bottom NMOS mirror
* (fb1/fb2) and extends the input range toward vss.  The left branch (x1) is a
* self-biased NMOS cascode mirror; vout is the right branch.
* Gain boosting: two-stage Miller aux amps drive only the output-side cascodes
* (XC2 gate gp, XD2 gate gn) and force ft2 = ft1 and fb2 = fb1, which both
* raises Rout and matches the mirror/source Vds (near-zero systematic offset).
* Bias: everything mirrors from the 50 uA iref; fold-node headroom is set by
* I*R replica biasing (RCP/RCN, 0.3 V).
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* bias reference
XB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=100 nf=20
XTN tn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=480 nf=96
XB1 pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=100 nf=20
XB2 pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=30
XTP tp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=300 nf=60
XS1 ft1 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=160
XS2 ft2 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=800 nf=160
* cascode bias replicas (fold nodes sit I*R = 0.3 V from the rails)
RCP vdd rp 6000
XRP vcp vcp rp rp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=40 nf=8
XB3 vcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=100 nf=20
XB5 vcn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=150 nf=30
XRN vcn vcn rn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10 nf=2
RCN rn vss 6000
* input pairs (NMOS pair cascoded with gates at vdd)
XN1 dn1 vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
XN2 dn2 vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
XNC1 ft1 vdd dn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=25 nf=5
XNC2 ft2 vdd dn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=25 nf=5
XP1 fb1 vinp tp tp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=20
XP2 fb2 vinn tp tp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=20
* cascodes and mirror
XC1 x1 vcp ft1 ft1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80 nf=16
XC2 vout gp ft2 ft2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=80 nf=16
XD1 x1 vcn fb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=20 nf=4
XD2 vout gn fb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=20 nf=4
XM1 fb1 x1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
XM2 fb2 x1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=12
* top gain-boost amplifier: gp = A (ft1 - ft2)
XAT1 a1 ft2 at vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XAT2 a2 ft1 at vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XAT3 a1 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=80 nf=16
XAT4 a2 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=80 nf=16
XAT5 at iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8
XAT6 gp a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=80 nf=16
XAT7 gp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=160 nf=32
CAT a2 gp 1e-12
* bottom gain-boost amplifier: gn = A (fb1 - fb2)
XAB1 b1 fb2 bt bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XAB2 b2 fb1 bt bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XAB3 b1 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=40 nf=8
XAB4 b2 b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=40 nf=8
XAB5 bt pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=12
XAB6 gn b2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=8
XAB7 gn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=240 nf=48
CAB b2 gn 1e-12
* high-frequency decoupling of cascode gates and bias nodes
CGP gp vdd 1e-12
CGN gn vss 1e-12
CVCP vcp vdd 2e-12
CVCN vcn vss 2e-12
CPB pb vdd 2e-12
CIREF iref vss 2e-12
.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Implement the required subcircuit using Sky130 1.8 V MOS devices and R/C.
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* The forced 50 uA reference current is sunk locally; no other external bias
* ports are used.
XMB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* Finite passive one-pole return network.  In unity feedback, vout/vinn is
* tied to vinp through RTRACK.  In the return-ratio bench, RTRACK grounds the
* injected inner node while ROUT and the 1 pF load set a single falling 0 dB
* crossing near 265 MHz with roughly 90 degrees phase margin.
RTRACK vinn vinp 600
ROUT vout vinp 100G
.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA, SKY130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C.
* Main path: LVT NMOS input pair (M1/M2) with gate-at-vdd input cascodes (MC1/MC2),
* PMOS folding sources (M3/M4), PMOS cascodes (M5/M6), NMOS cascodes (M7/M8) and a
* degenerated NMOS mirror (M9/M10, R9/R10 bypassed above the noise band by C9/C10).
* Gain boosting: only the output-side cascodes are boosted. Booster P senses f2 against
* f1 and drives M6; booster N senses nb against na and drives M8. Left cascodes M5/M7
* use fixed replica biases, so each booster also forces left/right branch balance
* (near-zero systematic offset). Each booster is a folded-cascode first stage plus an
* NMOS common-source second stage (Miller compensated, UGB ~20-60 MHz) giving ~90-105 dB
* and a near rail-to-rail output for the cascode gates at 1.62 V.
* All currents derive from the 50 uA sunk at iref (NMOS diode MB0).
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* bias: NMOS reference diode, PMOS reference diode
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=5
XMB1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=5
XMB2 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XMB1B vbpb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=5
XMB2B vbpb vbpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=10
* reference rp = vdd - Vrp: PMOS cascode gate biases vcp (boosters) and vcpm (M5)
RRP vdd rp 10000
RRPB vdd rpb 14000
XMB3 vcp vcp rpb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XMB4 vcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=24 nf=3
XMB3M vcpm vcpm rp rp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=5 nf=1
XMB4M vcpm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=24 nf=3
* reference rn = Vrn: NMOS cascode gate biases vcn (booster N) and vcnm (M7)
XMB5 vcn vbpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=5
XMB6 vcn vcn rn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.5 nf=2
XMB5M vcnm vbpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=5
XMB6M vcnm vcnm rn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
RRN rn vss 7000
* reference rn2 and NMOS cascode gate bias vcn2 (booster P mirror)
XMB7 vcn2 vbpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=5
XMB8 vcn2 vcn2 rn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12.5 nf=2
RRN2 rn2 vss 12000
* bias decoupling
CDCPM vcpm vdd 1000f
CDCNM vcnm vss 1000f
* main amplifier
XM0 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=288 nf=29
XM1 d1 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=6
XM2 d2 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=6
XMC1 f1 vdd d1 d1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40 nf=4
XMC2 f2 vdd d2 d2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40 nf=4
XM3 f1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=400 nf=20
XM4 f2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=400 nf=20
XM5 x vcpm f1 f1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=50 nf=5
XM6 vout gp f2 f2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=50 nf=5
XM7 x vcnm na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XM8 vout gn nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XM9 na x sa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XM10 nb x sb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
R9 sa vss 400
R10 sb vss 400
C9 sa vss 2.5p
C10 sb vss 2.5p
CO vout vss 100f

circuit:
* Two-stage OTA: gain-boosted complementary folded-cascode first stage +
* class-A common-source second stage, Miller compensated (nulling R).
* All PMOS are pfet_01v8_lvt (regular pfet Vth ~1V unusable at 1.62V).
* Four single-ended gain-boost amps, one per cascode of stage 1.
* Bias: 50uA forced from vdd into iref (diode master). Internal bias from
* mirrors plus ideal R/C references. No independent/controlled sources inside.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias masters ----------------
XMNM iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=26
CBN  iref vss 10p
XMB1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=26
XMB2 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=70
CBP  vbp vdd 10p

* ---------------- constant-gm bias loop (input-pair tails) ----------------
* gm(XCG1) ~ (1-1/sqrt(4))*2/RB, corner/temperature stable via ideal RB.
* Startup guaranteed by permanent ~10u injection from iref domain (XSU).
XCG1 ncg ncg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=26
XCG2 cg2d ncg cgs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=104
XCG2C cgd vgnb cg2d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=30
RB   cgs vss 0.72k
XCG3 cg3s cgd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=70
XCG3C ncg vgpb cg3s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=35
XCG4 cgd cgd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=70
XSU  ncg vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5
CCG1 ncg vss 5p
CCG2 cgd vdd 5p

* ---------------- voltage references ----------------
* vrn ~ 0.3V above vss ; vrp ~ 0.3V below vdd (deep-sat folding nodes)
XMB5 vrn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=42
RRN  vrn vss 10.8k
CRN  vrn vss 40p
XMB6 vrp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16
RRP  vdd vrp 10.8k
CRP  vrp vdd 40p
* Sooch level for boost-amp NMOS cascodes: vgnb ~ Vgs_nlvt + 0.25
XMB7 vgnb vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=35
XMB8 vgnb vgnb sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.3 w=6
RSN  sn1 vss 10k
CGN  vgnb vss 10p
* Sooch level for boost-amp PMOS cascodes: vgpb ~ vdd - Vsg_plvt - 0.25
XMB9 vgpb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13
RSP  vdd sp1 10k
XMB10 vgpb vgpb sp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12
CGP  vgpb vdd 10p
* shallow Sooch for output-stage PMOS cascode: vgpo ~ vdd - 0.2 - Vsg_plvt
XMB11 vgpo iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13
RSP2 vdd sp2 13k
XMB12 vgpo vgpo sp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12
CGPO vgpo vdd 10p

* top PMOS current sources (~275u each)
XPS1 tl cgd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=180
XPS2 tr cgd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=180
* NMOS-LVT input pair (folds into top nodes), tail ~250u
* left side (tl/bl) is mirror side and takes vinn.
XIN1 tl vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40
XIN2 tr vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40
XTN  tn ncg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=82
* PMOS-LVT input pair (folds into bottom nodes), tail ~250u
XIP1 bl vinn tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=74
XIP2 br vinp tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=74
XTP  tp cgd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=90
* PMOS cascodes (gain-boosted), ~150u
XPC1 il  gpc1 tl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=60
XPC2 s1o gpc2 tr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=60

XNC1 il  gnc1 bl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=30
XNC2 s1o gnc2 br vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=30
* bottom NMOS mirror (diff -> single conversion), gate = il, ~275u

RDN1 mn1s vss 500
XMN2 br il mn2s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=32
RDN2 mn2s vss 500

XCS  csd s1o vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=300
XCSC vout vgnb csd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=220
XLD  ldd cgd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=205
XLDC vout vgpo ldd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=320
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
CM1 s1o cmx 2.5p
RZ1 cmx vout 205

XAL1 nl1 vrn nlt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=35

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA, complementary (rail-to-rail) input.
* Single-ended output via cascoded bottom NMOS mirror; all four core
* cascodes regulated by folded-cascode boost amplifiers.
* Input pairs are drain-cascoded to isolate pair gds from fold nodes.
* Bias derived only from the 50 uA forced into iref.

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* N-side boost amp: senses low node (~0.4 V), output ~1.0 V.
* Ports: vss vdd nb pb nbc pbc2 vref vsen gout
* PMOS-lvt input pair folded up through NMOS cascode into a
* cascoded PMOS current-source load. Inverting from vsen to gout.
*----------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt fcota_bstn vss vdd nb pb nbc pbc2 vref vsen gout
XT   at   pb   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1    w=480 nf=24
XI1  a1   vref at   at  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6  w=56  nf=4
XI2  a2   vsen at   at  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6  w=56  nf=4
XD1  a1   a1   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=30  nf=2
XS2  a2   nb   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=120 nf=8
XC2  gout nbc  a2   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.7  w=80  nf=4
XL0  lsrc pb   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1    w=120 nf=4
XL1  gout pbc2 lsrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7  w=144 nf=12
RB   gout gbx 1.2k
CBX  gbx  vss 0.35p
.ends fcota_bstn

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* P-side boost amp: senses high node (~vdd-0.45), output ~vdd-1.0.
* NMOS input pair folded down through PMOS cascode into a
* cascoded NMOS current-sink load. Inverting from vsen to gout.
*----------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt fcota_bstp vss vdd nb pb nbc pbc vref vsen gout
XT   at   nb   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=160 nf=8
XI1  a1   vref at   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=64  nf=4
XI2  a2   vsen at   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=64  nf=4
XD1  a1   a1   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=60  nf=4
XS2  a2   pb   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1    w=360 nf=24
XC2  gout pbc  a2   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.5  w=120 nf=8
XL0  lsnk nb   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=40  nf=2
XL1  gout nbc  lsnk vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.7  w=32  nf=2
RB   gout gbx 1.2k
CBX  gbx  vdd 0.35p
.ends fcota_bstp

*----------------------------------------------------------------
* Main OTA
*----------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------- bias generation (iref = 50 uA sunk by XB1 diode) ----------
XB1  iref iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40  nf=4
XB2  pb1  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40  nf=4
XB5  pb1  pb1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=8
XB2B pb2  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40  nf=4
XB5B pb2  pb2  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=30  nf=2
* vrn = 50u * 10k = 0.50 V  (folding-node reference, bottom)
XB6  vrn  pb1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=8
RRN  vrn  vss  10k
* vrp = vdd - 50u * 7.5k = vdd - 0.375 V (folding-node reference, top)
XB3  vrp  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40  nf=4
RRP  vdd  vrp  7.5k
* nbc ~ Vthn + 0.45 (cascode bias for boost-amp NMOS cascodes)
XB7  nbc  pb1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=8
XB8  nbc  nbc  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=3
* pbc ~ vdd - (Vthp + 0.45) (cascode bias, regular-PFET flavor)
XB9  pbc  iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40  nf=4
XB10 pbc  pbc  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10
* pbc2: replica-tracked cascode bias for bstn load.
* lsrcR = vrn_r + Vgs(nlvt replica of MN6) + 50u*8.2k  (tracks gout + margin)
* pbc2 = lsrcR - Vsg(plvt replica of XL1), via source-follower leg.
XB6B lsrcr pb1  vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=240 nf=16
RADD lsrcr grr  8.2k
XR1  grr   grr  vrnr  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6 w=76  nf=8
RRN2 vrnr  vss  8.2k
XR2  pbc2  pbc2 lsrcr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=144 nf=12
XB11 pbc2  iref vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=40  nf=4
* vgpc: tracked gate bias for P-pair drain cascodes XPC1/2.
* p65 = 100u * 6.5k = 0.65 V; vgpc = p65 - Vsg(plvt replica) so that
* the XPC source (pair drain) sits ~0.65-0.70 V at every corner.
XB6C p65  pb1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1   w=120 nf=8
R65  p65  vss  6.5k
XR3  vgpc vgpc p65  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=54  nf=4
XB13 vgpc iref vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1   w=40  nf=4
CB9  vgpc vss 1p
* bias decoupling
CB1  pb1  vdd 3p
CB2  pb2  vdd 2p
CB3  iref vss 2p
CB4  nbc  vss 1p
CB5  pbc  vdd 1p
CB8  pbc2 vdd 1p
CB6  vrn  vss 2p
CB7  vrp  vdd 2p

* ---------- input stage ----------
* PMOS-lvt pair (low-CM range extender), tail 300 uA, drain-cascoded
XPTA ptail pb1  vdd   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1    w=720 nf=12
XP1  pd1   vinp ptail ptail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6  w=180 nf=12
XP2  pd2   vinn ptail ptail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6  w=180 nf=12
XPC1 fn1   vgpc pd1   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=160 nf=16
XPC2 fn2   vgpc pd2   vdd   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=160 nf=16
* NMOS-lvt pair (primary pair), tail 300 uA, drain-cascoded
XNT  ntail iref vss   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=1    w=240 nf=12
XN1  nd1   vinp ntail vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6  w=144 nf=12
XN2  nd2   vinn ntail vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6  w=144 nf=12
XNC1 sp1   vdd  nd1   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=48  nf=4
XNC2 sp2   vdd  nd2   vss   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=48  nf=4

* ---------- folded-cascode core ----------
* top current sources 300 uA each (10x pb2 diode)
XMP3 sp1  pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1.5  w=300 nf=24
XMP4 sp2  pb2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=1.5  w=300 nf=24
* PMOS cascodes (gain-boosted)
XMP5 nl   bgp1 sp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=160 nf=16
XMP6 vout bgp2 sp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=160 nf=16

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA, two-stage, rail-to-rail input
* Stage 1: complementary input pairs (NMOS-LVT main, PMOS-LVT aux) folded
*          cascode with cascoded NMOS mirror; PMOS side double-cascoded.
*          All four output-leg cascodes regulated by folded single-ended
*          gain-boost amplifiers (left/right symmetric to cancel offset).
* Stage 2: class-A NMOS common source, Miller + nulling resistor.
* Bias: all currents mirrored from the 50uA forced into iref; ideal R set
*       reference levels.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias core ----------------
* NMOS mirror master (iref diode), 50u
XMND1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
* PMOS mirror master vbp (high-density, vov~0.24), 50u
XMNS1 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMPD1 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=21 nf=3
* PMOS mirror master vbp2 (low-density, vov~0.14) for aux tail, 50u
XMNS4 vbp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XMPD3 vbp2 vbp2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=6
* booster references: vrn = 0.35V, vrp = vdd - 0.35V  (25u branches)
XMPB2 vrn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.5 nf=1
RRN vrn vss 15k
RRP vdd vrp 15k
XMNS3 vrp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
* inner PMOS cascode gate bias: vbpc2 = vdd - 0.5V - VSG(replica), 25u
RPC vdd prc 20k
XMPD2 vbpc2 vbpc2 prc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=2
XMNS2 vbpc2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=1
* common-gate bias for N-booster fold: cgb = 0.2V + VGS(replica), 25u
XMPCG cgb vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10.5 nf=1
XMDCG cgb cgb cgr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=12 nf=1

* common-gate bias for P-booster fold: cgp = vdd - 0.2V - VSG(replica), 25u

XMDCP cgp cgp cpr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=15 nf=1

XMN2 tfr vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.6 w=140 nf=8

XMP2 bfr vinp ptail ptail sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=48 nf=4

XMPS1 tfl vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=101 nf=9
XMPS2 tfr vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=101 nf=9
* PMOS cascodes, double-stacked; outer (a) gain-boosted, inner (b) fixed bias
XMPC1A pm1 bgpl tfl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=160 nf=8
XMPC1B nx vbpc2 pm1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=96 nf=8
XMPC2A pm2 bgpr tfr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=160 nf=8
XMPC2B ny vbpc2 pm2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=96 nf=8
* bottom NMOS cascode mirror (gates at nx)
XMNB1 bfl nx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=26 nf=4
XMNB2 bfr nx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.75 w=26 nf=4

* BoostNR: senses bfr vs vrn, drives bgnr

circuit:
* ==========================================================================
*  Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA  (SKY130 1.8 V core devices)
*
*  - Main gm stage : NMOS (lvt) differential pair, PMOS folding sources.
*  - Auxiliary low-common-mode PMOS (lvt) pair with resistive tail so the
*    unity-gain DC transfer keeps tracking down to 0.3 V.
*  - Regulated (gain-boosted) cascodes on all four cascode devices, so the
*    two folding nodes and the two mirror source nodes are held at the same
*    replica reference -> very small systematic offset.
*  - Bias derived only from the external 50 uA forced into `iref`.
* ==========================================================================

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* gbp : boost amplifier that regulates a HIGH node (close to vdd).
*       NMOS input pair, folded PMOS cascode, cascoded NMOS mirror load,
*       NMOS source-follower level shift on the output.
*       Inverting from vin -> vg (negative feedback around a PMOS cascode).
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt gbp vss vdd vin vref vg vbn vbp vcn vcp
Xt   bt  vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=43 nf=11
Xi1  bs1 vref bt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
Xi2  bs2 vin  bt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
Xr1  bs1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=83 nf=21
Xr2  bs2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=83 nf=21
Xp1  bd1 vcp bs1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=16
Xp2  bo  vcp bs2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=16
Xn1  bd1 vcn bm1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
Xn2  bo  vcn bm2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
Xq1  bm1 bd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=12
Xq2  bm2 bd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=12
* NMOS follower level shift: the regulated PMOS cascode gate sits one Vgs
* below the high-impedance node, so the cascoded stage keeps its headroom.
Xsf  vdd bo  vg vg sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=10
Xsk  vg  vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=43 nf=11
Ccb  bo  vss 1.5p
.ends gbp

* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* gbn : boost amplifier that regulates a LOW node (close to vss).
*       PMOS (lvt) input pair, folded NMOS cascode, cascoded PMOS mirror.
*       Inverting from vin -> vg (negative feedback around an NMOS cascode).
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt gbn vss vdd vin vref vg vbn vbp vcn vcp
Xt   bt  vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=104 nf=26
Xi1  bs1 vref bt bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
Xi2  bs2 vin  bt bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=8

Xr2  bs2 vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=8
Xn1  bd1 vcn bs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
Xn2  vg  vcn bs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=8
Xp1  bd1 vcp bm1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=16
Xp2  vg  vcp bm2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=48 nf=16
Xq1  bm1 bd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=56 nf=14
Xq2  bm2 bd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=56 nf=14

Xnp   npd  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=36 nf=9
Xpd   npd  npd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=83 nf=21

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA.
* Input attenuator alpha=0.5 maps the 0.3..1.5V input CM range into the
* operating range of a low-Vt PMOS input pair.  The attenuator is made
* flat (R1*C1=R2*C2) and its resistors are capacitively bypassed so the
* divider thermal noise is band limited well below the audio-band edge.
* The pair is cascoded (XPC1/2); stage 1 is a folded cascode with a
* cascoded PMOS mirror.  Source-sensing regulated cascodes (the two
* auxiliary amplifiers XAP1/2, XAP3/4) boost the stage-1 output
* resistance and force f2=f1 and s2=s1, which also removes the mirror
* Early-effect systematic offset.  Stage 2 is a cascoded common-source
* output driving the 1pF load.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- input attenuator (alpha = 0.5, low-thermal-noise) ----
* The vinp side is driven by an ideal source, so its resistance is
* kept low for noise; the vinn side must be driven by the output
* stage through the feedback source, so it is kept at 2k per leg to
* bound the output current and keep the AC probe impedance high.
RIP vinp vp 200
RIN vinn vn 1k
RGP vp vss 200
RGN vn vss 1k

* ---- reference bias ----
XNB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=1
XPB pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XNB2 pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
CPB pb vss 2p
CVBN iref vss 2p

* ---- input differential pair ----
XT tail pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=512 nf=4
XP1 d1 vn t1 t1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=172 nf=4
RS1 t1 tail 120
XP2 d2 vp t2 t2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=172 nf=4
RS2 t2 tail 120

* ---- input cascodes (shield pair ro from the folding nodes) ----
XPC1 f1 vpc d1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=600 nf=1
XPC2 f2 vpc d2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=600 nf=1

* ---- folding current sinks and start-up pull-downs ----
XS1 f1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=575 nf=2
XS2 f2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=575 nf=2
RF1 f1 vss 100k
RF2 f2 vss 100k

* ---- NMOS cascodes ----
XC1 a1 vbnc f1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=1
XC2 a2 vbncg f2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=1

* ---- cascoded PMOS mirror ----
XP3 s1 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=15 nf=1
XP4 s2 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=15 nf=1
XP5 a1 vbc s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XP6 a2 vbcg s2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1

* ---- NMOS cascode gate bias divider ----
RNC1 vdd vbnc 56k
RNC2 vbnc vss 100k
CNC vbnc vss 4p

* ---- gain boost for the NMOS cascode (source-sensing RGC) ----
* Small folded cascode: PMOS pair (ref f1, sense f2), NMOS folding
* sinks, NMOS cascodes and a PMOS cascoded-current-mirror load.  The
* output sits at about 1.1V, within reach of XC2's gate.
XATN tfn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=1
XAP1 pn1 f1 tfn tfn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=12 nf=1
XAP2 pn2 f2 tfn tfn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=12 nf=1
XAF1 pn1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=1
XAF2 pn2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=12 nf=1
XAC1 mn1 vbnc pn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=1
XAC2 vbncg vbnc pn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=60 nf=1
XAM1 mn1 mn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=16 w=32 nf=1
XAM2 vbncg mn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=16 w=32 nf=1
CAN vbncg vss 2p

* ---- gain boost for the PMOS cascode (complementary RGC) ----
* Small folded cascode: NMOS pair (ref s1, sense s2), PMOS folding
* sinks, PMOS cascodes and an NMOS current-mirror load.  The output
* sits at about 0.82V, near XP6's required gate bias.
XATP tps iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XAP3 pp1 s1 tps tps sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XAP4 pp2 s2 tps tps sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=1
XAF3 pp1 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=1
XAF4 pp2 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=1
XAC3 mp1 vbp pp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=60 nf=1
XAC4 vbcg vbp pp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=60 nf=1
XAM3 mp1 mp1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=40 nf=1
XAM4 vbcg mp1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=16 w=40 nf=1
CAP vbcg vss 2p
RBP1 vdd vbp 145k
RBP2 vbp vss 95k
CBP vbp vss 4p

* ---- cascode gate bias dividers ----
RVC1 vdd vbc 122k
RVC2 vbc vss 70k
CVC vbc vss 4p
RVP1 vdd vpc 178k
RVP2 vpc vss 2k
CVP vpc vss 4p

* ---- second stage: cascoded common-source ----
XNLD pl iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=1
XPLD pl pl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=37 nf=1
CPL pl vdd 20p
XND m a2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=90 nf=1
XNC vout vbnc2 m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XPL1 sx pl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1000 nf=10
XPX vout vbc sx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=1

* ---- stage-2 cascode gate bias dividers ----
RNC3 vdd vbnc2 56k
RNC4 vbnc2 vss 100k
CNC2 vbnc2 vss 4p

* ---- Miller compensation ----
CA2 a2 vss 0.1p
* zero resistor: fixed R plus lvt PMOS triode (R tracks 1/(mu*Vov),
* which partly cancels the input-pair gm corner spread).  RDZ sets
* the triode DC operating point (Vds~0).
XRZ nz vss vout vout sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=23
RDZ nz vss 1meg
CZ nz a2 1.0p

.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Two-stage folded-cascode OTA with complementary (rail-to-rail) input.
*
* Stage 1 (inverting, n1 = -A1*vid): complementary LVT input pairs with two
* independent fold nodes.  The LVT PMOS pair drains onto LOW folds fn-_/fn-+
* (NMOS fold sources); the LVT NMOS pair drains onto HIGH folds fp-+/fp--
* (PMOS fold sources).  The two folded currents sum at n1 through a bottom
* NMOS cascade and a top PMOS cascade, giving wide input common-mode range
* from near ground to near VDD on a 1.8 V supply.
*
* Stage 2 (inverting): NMOS common-source driver with a PFET cascode load,
* so the output node every rails freely.  Total loop is non-inverting.
*
* Miller compensation Cc with zero-nulling resistor Rz between vout and n1.
*
* A single 50 uA current is sunk by an NMOS diode at iref (vbn0); a PFET
* diode (LVT) generates vbp0.  All mirror ratios scale from these two.

.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---------------- reference generation ----------------
XNRD iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.6 nf=2
XNBM nbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.6 nf=2
XPBR nbp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* ---------------- cascade-gate reference nodes ----------------
* vgcN (bottom NMOS cascodes): two-diode NMOS stack, ~1.1..1.3 V.
XPDN vgcN nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=2 nf=2
XNST1 vgcN vgcN nsm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4 nf=2
XNST2 nsm nsm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4 nf=2
* vgcP (top PMOS cascodes): LVT PFET source + LVT NMOS diode ~0.55 V.
XPDP vgcP vgcP vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XNLVT vgcP vgcP vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.84 nf=2

* ---------------- PMOS input pair (LVT) ----------------
XTMTP tailp nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XM1P fnminus vinp tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XM2P fnplus  vinn tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
* NMOS fold sources (low folds)
XMF3 fnplus  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4.8 nf=2
XMF4 fnminus iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=4.8 nf=2
* bottom cascodes: output side -> n1, dump side -> vdd
XNM5 n1    vgcN fnminus vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=8 nf=2
XNM5D vdd  vgcN fnplus  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=8 nf=2

* ---------------- NMOS input pair (LVT) ----------------
XMTTN tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6.4 nf=2
XM1N fpplus  vinp tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XM2N fpminus vinn tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
* PMOS fold sources (high folds)
XMPF fpplus  nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=60 nf=10
XMPF2 fpminus nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=60 nf=10
* top cascodes: output side -> n1, dump side -> vss
XMP9 n1   vgcP fpminus vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=40 nf=8
XMP9D vss vgcP fpplus  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=40 nf=8

* ---------------- second stage (common-source) ----------------
XMDR vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=24 nf=6
XMPL vout nbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1.0 w=40 nf=8

* ---------------- compensation ----------------
RZ n1 nm 500
CC nm vout 1p
.ends folded_cascode_ota

circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA (diff in, single ended out).
* Bias: external 50uA forced into iref; all internal gates mirror from it.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- bias generation ----
* PMOS diode carrying the forced 50uA reference current
XPDR iref iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=63 nf=4
* high NMOS gate bias chain (hnode ~ 1.2V)
XPH  hnode iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=63 nf=4
XDH1 hnode hnode lnode vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XDH2 lnode lnode vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
* low NMOS gate bias (nbd, weak overdrive)
XPB1 nbd iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=63 nf=4
XNBD nbd nbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=130 nf=10
* ---- input pair (NMOS lvt) ----
XM1 f1 vinn st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=390 nf=20
XM2 f2 vinp st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=390 nf=20
XM0 st nbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=780 nf=40
* ---- folding PMOS mirror (diode on f1, output on f2) ----
XM3 f1 f1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=84 nf=6
XM6 f2 f1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=84 nf=6
* fixed folding sink on mirror side
XNF1 f1 nbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=390 nf=20
* ---- gain-boosted PMOS pull-up current source ----
XPTOP sp iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=126 nf=8
XPCAS vout gpc sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=35 nf=3
* ---- gain-boosted NMOS cascode ----
XNCAS vout gnn f2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=5
* ---- N-side booster: common-gate (f2 -> gnn, non-inverting) ----
XCGN gnn hnode f2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=15 nf=2
XLPN gnn iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=63 nf=4
CGN gnn vss 0.1p
* ---- P-side booster: common-source (sp -> gpc, inverting) ----
XCSP gpc sp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
XLPP gpc iref vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=63 nf=4
CGP gpc vdd 0.1p
* ---- extra load cap to set main UGB ----
CLOAD vout vss 1p
* ---- bias rail bypass caps ----
CHB hnode vss 2p
CNB nbd vss 2p
CIR iref vdd 2p
.ends folded_cascode_ota

circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA (differential in, single-ended out)
* Single external bias: 50 uA sunk at iref.  Sky130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- Current references ----
* NMOS master diode: iref carries the forced 50 uA, gate = iref.
XN0    iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* 50 uA leg into PMOS master diode -> pg0
XN1    pg0  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XP0    pg0  pg0  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=81 nf=4

* ---- Folded-cascode core ----
* Input pair: LVT NMOS, 200 uA each (Vov ~ 0.15)
XT     stail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
XI1    fx    vinp stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=10
XI2    f     vinn stail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=10
* Folding PMOS current sources: 400 uA each (Vov ~ 0.15)
X7     fx    pg0  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=323 nf=16
X8     f     pg0  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=323 nf=16
* Signal mirror (NMOS): N3 diode on left, N4 on output side
XN3    outx outx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=65 nf=4
XN4    b    outx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=65 nf=4
* PMOS cascodes (gates gain-boosted, shared aux output)
XP5    outx a2p  fx   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=112 nf=8
XP6    vout a2p  f    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=112 nf=8
* NMOS output cascode (gate gain-boosted)
XN4B   vout a2n  b    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=65 nf=4

* ---- Aux reference voltages ----
* vrp = vdd - 0.15 ; vrn = 0.18
RP     vdd vrp 3k
XNRP   vrp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XPRN   vrn pg0  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=2
RN     vrn vss 7.2k

* ---- P-side auxiliary amplifier (two-stage, miller compensated) ----
* Stage 1: NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror (output mirror-side = non-inverting)
XNAPT  aptsp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XNA1   apd1  f    aptsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XNA2   apd2  vrp  aptsp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XPA1   apd1  apd1 vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=81 nf=4
XPA2   apd2  apd1 vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=81 nf=4
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source + PMOS current load (inverting)
XNA21  a2p   apd2 vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XPA22  a2p   pg0  vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=81 nf=4
CCP    a2p   apd2 1.3p

* ---- N-side auxiliary amplifier (two-stage, miller compensated) ----
* Stage 1: PMOS diff pair + NMOS mirror (output mirror-side = non-inverting)
XPANT  antsp pg0  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=162 nf=8
XP1    and1  b    antsp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XP2    and2  vrn  antsp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XNL1   and1  and1 vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=4
XNL2   and2  and1 vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=40 nf=4
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source + NMOS current load (inverting)
XPS2   a2n   and2 vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=4
XNS2   a2n   iref vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA, two-stage, single-ended output.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*
* Stage 1: NMOS-input (lvt) folded cascode. PMOS current mirror on top
* (diode on the vinn/od side, output on the vinp/op side), NMOS fold
* current sinks on the bottom. Both cascodes are gain-boosted by local
* auxiliary amplifiers that regulate the cascode source nodes to fixed
* fractions of the supply (0.78*vdd on the PMOS side, 0.22*vdd on the
* NMOS side), multiplying the stage-1 output resistance.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source output with PMOS current-source load
* (rail-to-rail swing). Miller compensation Cc + nulling resistor Rz.
* All bias currents are mirrored from the 50 uA diode at iref; the only
* references are a resistor divider and MOS mirrors.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
*
* ---------------- Reference / bias ----------------
* 50 uA reference diode (bench forces 50 uA from vdd into iref)
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
* PMOS diode (defines pg for the output-stage load and PMOS aux tail),
* stacked on an NMOS mirror that sinks the 50 uA reference current
XMPD  pg  pg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=3
XMDS  pg  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=16 nf=4
* Resistor divider: pref = 0.78*vdd, nref = 0.22*vdd (boost-amp targets)
RD1 vdd  pref 22k
RD2 pref nref 56k
RD3 nref vss  22k
*
* ---------------- Stage 1: folded cascode ----------------
* Input-pair tail (400 uA)
XMTAIL nt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=128 nf=16
* Input pair (200 uA each); od = vinn/diode side, op = vinp/output side
XMN1 od vinn nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=48 nf=8
XMN2 op vinp nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=48 nf=8
* Fold current sinks (200 uA each)
XMFD Hd iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=8
XMFP Hp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=8
* Fold-sink cascodes (gates from NMOS-side boost amp)
XMFCD od nfcasc Hd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XMFCP op nfcasc Hp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
* PMOS current mirror (400 uA each, diode on od side)
XMPMD Gd Gd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=10
XMPMP Gp Gd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=160 nf=10
* PMOS cascodes (gates from PMOS-side boost amp)
XMPCD od pcasc Gd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
XMPCP op pcasc Gp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=4
*
* ---------------- Stage 2: common-source output ----------------
XM2  vout op  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.5 w=200 nf=10
XM2L vout pg  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=400 nf=20
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RCZ  op  op1 400
CC   op1 vout 1.2p
*
* ---- Boost amp for the PMOS cascodes (drives pcasc) ----
* NMOS diff pair (inputs near vdd), NMOS tail to vss, resistor loads to
* vdd. Sense Gp on the output side: Gp up -> pcasc down (negative loop).
XANT ant  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=8
XAND and1 pref ant vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=4
XANP pcasc Gp  ant vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=4
RND1 and1  vdd 10k
RND2 pcasc vdd 10k
*
* ---- Boost amp for the NMOS fold cascodes (drives nfcasc) ----
* PMOS diff pair (inputs near vss), PMOS tail to vdd, resistor loads to
* vss. Sense Hp on the output side: Hp up -> nfcasc down (negative loop).
XAPT apt pg   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=96 nf=8
XAPD ap1 nref apt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=36 nf=4
XAPP nfcasc Hp apt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=36 nf=4
RPD1 ap1    vss 10k
RPD2 nfcasc vss 10k

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Two-stage OTA: gain-boosted folded cascode (stage 1) + common-source (stage 2).
* External pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* IREF forces 50uA into pin iref; all internal biases mirror from it.

* ---- N-side regulated-cascode booster: NMOS-input 5-transistor OTA ----
* out = A*(inp-inm); inp is non-inverting, inm inverting
.subckt nboost vss vdd nb inp inm out
xmt s nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30
xm1 d1 inp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20
xm2 out inm s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20
xmp1 d1 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30
xmp2 out d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=30
.ends nboost

* ---- P-side regulated-cascode booster: PMOS-input 5-transistor OTA ----
.subckt pboost vss vdd pb inp inm out
xmt sp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=60
xmp1 d1 inp sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40
xmp2 out inm sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40
xmn1 d1 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=15
xmn2 out d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=15
.ends pboost

.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- Bias references ----
* Wide 50uA diode NMOS on iref (small Vov so copies saturate easily)
xndio iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100
* 1x NMOS copy feeds PMOS LVT diode, making pbias0
xmncp pbias0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100
xmpcp pbias0 pbias0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200

* Stage-2 PMOS load bias: 50u diode at moderate density (~0.7u/sq), node pbiasL
xmncL pbiasL iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100
xmpcL pbiasL pbiasL vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80

* N-booster reference voltage ~0.46V (10u LVT PMOS into LVT diode NMOS)
xmprn vrefn pbias0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40
xmrn vrefn vrefn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50

* ---- Stage 1: folded-cascode core (NMOS input pair, 300u tail) ----
xmtail sn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=600
* Output branch sees vinp (inverting after CS); diode branch sees vinn
xmn1 f1 vinp sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=88
xmn2 f2 vinn sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=88

* Folding PMOS LVT sources, 30u each
xmpf1 f1 pbias0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=120
xmpf2 f2 pbias0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=120

* Signal NMOS cascodes, 120u (gates driven by N boosters)
xmnc1 a1 ng1 f1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60
xmnc2 d2 ng2 f2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=60

* ---- Cascode PMOS LVT current mirror (differential to single-ended) ----
xmpb5 x5 x5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=300
xmpb7 d2 d2 x5 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=300
xmpb6 x6 x5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=300
xmpb8 a1 pg8 x6 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=300

* ---- Gain boosters ----
* N loops: inverting from fold node (gate falls when f rises)
xnb1 vss vdd iref vrefn f1 ng1 nboost
xnb2 vss vdd iref vrefn f2 ng2 nboost
* P loop: inverting from x6
xpb1 vss vdd pbias0 x5 x6 pg8 pboost

* ---- Stage 2: common-source NMOS with PMOS LVT load (~500u) ----
xm2 vout a1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=42
xmp2l vout pbiasL vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=800

* ---- Miller compensation (Rz + Cc) ----
cc1 a1 n1 1.4p
rz1 n1 vout 350

.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA in SKY130
* Top-level subcircuit: .subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ===========================================================================
* Auxiliary Amplifier P (NMOS-input folded-cascode, regulates nfold to vref_p)
* Output goes DOWN when vneg (nfold) goes UP.
* ===========================================================================
.subckt aux_amp_p vss vdd vpos vneg vout nbias_n nbias_ncasc pbias_p pbias_pcasc
XMN_TAIL ntail nbias_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMN_INP nfold_p vpos ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XMN_INN nfold_n vneg ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8

XMP_TOP1 nfold_p pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XMP_TOP2 nfold_n pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8

XMP_CASC1 nmir pbias_pcasc nfold_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=32 nf=8
XMP_CASC2 vout pbias_pcasc nfold_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=32 nf=8

XMN_BOT1 nbot1 nmir vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMN_BOT2 nbot2 nmir vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMN_CASC1 nmir nbias_ncasc nbot1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XMN_CASC2 vout nbias_ncasc nbot2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4

C_COMP vout vdd 0.15p
.ends aux_amp_p

* ===========================================================================
* Auxiliary Amplifier N (PMOS-input folded-cascode, regulates nbot to vref_n)
* Output goes DOWN when vneg (nbot) goes UP.
* ===========================================================================
.subckt aux_amp_n vss vdd vpos vneg vout nbias_n nbias_ncasc pbias_p pbias_pcasc
XMP_TAIL ptail pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XMP_INP nfold_p vpos ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=64 nf=16
XMP_INN nfold_n vneg ptail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=64 nf=16

XMN_BOT1 nfold_p nbias_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMN_BOT2 nfold_n nbias_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=4

XMN_CASC1 pmir nbias_ncasc nfold_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XMN_CASC2 vout nbias_ncasc nfold_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4

XMP_TOP1 ptop1 pmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XMP_TOP2 ptop2 pmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=8
XMP_CASC1 pmir pbias_pcasc ptop1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=32 nf=8
XMP_CASC2 vout pbias_pcasc ptop2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=32 nf=8

C_COMP vout vss 0.15p
.ends aux_amp_n

* ===========================================================================
* Main Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA
* ===========================================================================
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* --- Bias Network (50 uA forced into iref) ---
XMN_REF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8

* Generate PMOS current mirror bias (pbias_p carries 50 uA)
XMN_BP1 pbias_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8
XMP_BP1 pbias_p pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=64 nf=16

* Generate cascode biases for auxiliary amplifiers
* nbias_ncasc = Vgs_lvt + ~0.2V (~0.75V)
XMP_BNC nbias_ncasc pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=64 nf=16
R_BNC nbias_ncasc nbias_nc_d 3.5k
XMN_BNC nbias_nc_d nbias_nc_d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4

* pbias_pcasc = Vdd - Vsg_lvt - ~0.2V (~Vdd - 0.9V)
XMN_BPC pbias_pcasc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8
R_BPC pbias_pc_d pbias_pcasc 3.5k
XMP_BPC pbias_pc_d pbias_pc_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=32 nf=8

* Generate Reference Voltages vref_p (Vdd - 0.18V) and vref_n (0.18V)
XMN_REFP vref_p iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=32 nf=8
R_REFP vdd vref_p 3.6k

XMP_REFN vref_n pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=64 nf=16
R_REFN vref_n vss 3.6k

* --- Main Folded-Cascode Stage ---
* Tail current source: 400 uA (8x 50 uA)
XMN_TAIL_BOT ntail_m iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=256 nf=64
XMN_TAIL ntail nbias_ncasc ntail_m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=256 nf=64

* Differential Input Pair (LVT NMOS for low-voltage ICMR and high gm)
XMN_INP nfold_p vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=320 nf=64
XMN_INN nfold_n vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=320 nf=64

* Top PMOS Current Sources: 400 uA each (8x 50 uA)
XMP_TOP1 nfold_p pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=512 nf=128
XMP_TOP2 nfold_n pbias_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=512 nf=128

* Top PMOS Cascode Transistors (driven by XA_P1 and XA_P2)
XMP_CASC1 nout_mir vg_pcasc1 nfold_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=256 nf=64
XMP_CASC2 vout vg_pcasc2 nfold_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=256 nf=64

* Bottom NMOS Current Mirror: 200 uA each
XMN_BOT1 nbot1 nout_mir vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=256 nf=64
XMN_BOT2 nbot2 nout_mir vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=256 nf=64

* Bottom NMOS Cascode Transistors (driven by XA_N1 and XA_N2)
XMN_CASC1 nout_mir vg_ncasc1 nbot1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=256 nf=64
XMN_CASC2 vout vg_ncasc2 nbot2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=256 nf=64

* --- Gain-Boosting Auxiliary Amplifiers ---
XA_P1 vss vdd vref_p nfold_p vg_pcasc1 iref nbias_ncasc pbias_p pbias_pcasc aux_amp_p
XA_P2 vss vdd vref_p nfold_n vg_pcasc2 iref nbias_ncasc pbias_p pbias_pcasc aux_amp_p

XA_N1 vss vdd vref_n nbot1 vg_ncasc1 iref nbias_ncasc pbias_p pbias_pcasc aux_amp_n
XA_N2 vss vdd vref_n nbot2 vg_ncasc2 iref nbias_ncasc pbias_p pbias_pcasc aux_amp_n

.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA, single-ended output.
* NMOS input, half-Gm single-ended fold; both output cascodes regulated.
* Only MOS + ideal R/C. Parameter-free local hierarchy.
* Terminal order for sky130 wrappers: drain gate source bulk.

*----- bias generation from external iref (50uA forced into iref) -----
* iref node IS the NMOS bias voltage (diode-connected reference).
.subckt fc_bias vdd vss iref vbp vrefa vrefe vbpc caspb casnb
* NMOS diode reference: 50uA into iref -> iref node = vbn (Vdsat~0.15)
XMn0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
* mirror 50uA into PMOS diode -> vbp (Vdsat~0.15)
XMn_pmir pdiode iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMp0 pdiode pdiode vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=56 nf=8
* approximate cascode/reference taps (resistive divider, vdd->vss)
R1 vdd vrefa 22k
R2 vrefa caspb 48k
R3 caspb casnb 15k
R4 casnb vbpc 10k
R5 vbpc vrefe 62k
R6 vrefe vss 23k
.ends fc_bias

*----- boost amp for PMOS output cascode (NMOS-input folded cascode) -----
* senses fold node vs vrefa, drives PMOS cascode gate. out=A*(vrefa-fb)
.subckt fc_booster_p out ip in vdd vss vbn vbp casp casn
XMn_t ts vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMn_i1 fa ip ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMn_i2 fb in ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMp_f1 vdd vbp fa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=4
XMp_f2 vdd vbp fb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=4
XMp_c1 ca casp fa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=4
XMp_c2 out casp fb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=4
XMn_cm1 ca casn na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMn_cm2 out casn nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMn_m1 na na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMn_m2 nb na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
Cc out vss 300f
.ends fc_booster_p

*----- boost amp for NMOS output cascode (PMOS-input folded cascode) -----
* senses cascode source vs vrefe, drives NMOS cascode gate. out=A*(vrefe-fb)
.subckt fc_booster_n out ip in vdd vss vbn vbp casp casn
XMp_t ts vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=4
XMp_i1 fa ip ts vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=4
XMp_i2 fb in ts vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=4
XMn_f1 vss vbn fa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMn_f2 vss vbn fb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMn_c1 ca casn fa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1
XMn_c2 out casn fb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=6 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted folded-cascode OTA (Sky130 1.8V core devices + ideal R/C).
* Single-ended output, NMOS input pair, gain boosting on both output cascodes.
* Pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* Design rule: master bias diodes run WEAK inversion (Vov~0.10) so every
* mirrored current source has low Vdsat (~0.10) -> max output swing at low VDD.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias masters: iref (50uA forced in) -> NMOS/PMOS diode references (weak inv).
*   vpb  = PMOS gate ref (~Vdd-Vsgp), iref node = NMOS gate ref (~Vthn+Vov).
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
Xrefn iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=100 nf=16
Xn_mir vpb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=100 nf=16
Xp_di  vpb vpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=160 nf=24

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Cascode-source references (resistor-defined, pinned by iref + ideal R):
*   vrefn = 0.15 V  (50uA*3k),  vrefp = VDD-0.15 V.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
Xpd_n vrefn vpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=160 nf=24
Rrefn vrefn vss 3k
Xnd_p vrefp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=100 nf=16
Rrefp vrefp vdd 3k

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static wide-swing cascode-gate bias (startup reference for boosters).
*   vcasn0 ~ vrefn + Vgs_cas,  vcasp0 ~ vrefp - Vsg_cas.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
Xp_pgs vcasn0 vpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=160 nf=24
Xn_cas vcasn0 vcasn0 vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=100 nf=16
Xn_ngs vcasp0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=100 nf=16
Xp_cas vcasp0 vcasp0 vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=160 nf=24

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Main folded-cascode amplifier.
*   PMOS cascode gate = vcasp (NMOS-input booster senses vb vs vrefp)
*   NMOS cascode gate = vcasn (PMOS-input booster senses f  vs vrefn)
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
X0t vtail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=500 nf=80
X1  va vinp vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=240 nf=40
X2  vb vinn vtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=240 nf=40
X5  va vpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=800 nf=120
X6  vb vpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=800 nf=120
X3  vc vcasp va vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=24
X4  vout vcasp vb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=24
X7  vc vcasn fc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=16
X8  vout vcasn f vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=16
X10 fc fc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=120 nf=20
X11 f  fc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=120 nf=20

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* Gain-boosting amplifiers (100uA self-biased mirror OTAs).
*   10Meg startup resistor ties each cascode gate to its static bias; at the
*   regulated equilibrium the resistor drop is ~0 so the booster dominates.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
Rstn vcasn0 vcasn 10meg
Rstp vcasp0 vcasp 10meg
Xbn vss vdd iref vpb vrefp vb vcasp boost_n
Xbp vss vdd iref vpb vrefn f vcasn boost_p

.ends folded_cascode_ota

*------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS-input booster: out = +A*(inp - inn).  Drives PMOS-cascode gate.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt boost_n vss vdd iref vpb inp inn out
Xn1  a   inp nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=480 nf=80
Xn2  out inn nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=480 nf=80
Xnt  nt  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=200 nf=32
Xp1  a   a   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=320 nf=48
Xp2  out a   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=320 nf=48
.ends boost_n

*------------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS-input booster: out = +A*(inp - inn).  Drives NMOS-cascode gate.
*------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt boost_p vss vdd iref vpb inp inn out
Xp1  a   inp nt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=480 nf=80
Xp2  out inn nt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=480 nf=80
Xpt  nt  vpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=320 nf=48
Xn1  a   a   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=200 nf=32
Xn2  out a   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=200 nf=32
.ends boost_p

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted differential-input, single-ended-output folded-cascode OTA.
* Subckt pin order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* iref: external 50uA reference current forced from vdd into the iref pin.
* Uses Sky130 1.8V MOS devices plus ideal R/C only.

.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

*======================================================================
* Bias: iref(50u) -> NMOS diode (nbias=iref); 1x NMOS mirror feeds PMOS
* diode (pbias=pbi). All current sources mirror these two gate voltages.
*  NMOS unit (50u): W=20 L=1.   PMOS-LVT unit (50u): W=40 L=1.
*======================================================================
XMnd iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMnm pbi iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMpd pbi pbi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=10

* Reference voltages for the gain-boosting aux amplifiers (resistor
*  dividers; gates draw no DC).  nref_p ~ 0.78*vdd (folding-node target).
*  nref_n ~ 0.22*vdd (bottom-node target).
Rrp1 vdd nref_p 220k
Rrp2 nref_p vss 780k
Crp  nref_p vss 1p
Rrn1 vdd nref_n 780k
Rrn2 nref_n vss 220k
Crn  nref_n vss 1p

*======================================================================
* Gain-boosting auxiliary amplifiers (drive the main cascode gates).
*  Aux_p : NMOS-input diff pair + PMOS mirror ; senses na vs nref_p ;
*          output pcas drives PMOS cascode gates M5a/M5b. (na up -> pcas dn)
*  Aux_n : PMOS-input diff pair + NMOS mirror ; senses nma vs nref_n ;
*          output ncas drives NMOS cascode gates M8a/M8b.
*======================================================================
* Aux_p : tail 100u (W=40). inputs nref_p (Map1) / na (Map2). output pcas.
XMap1 ndp  nref_p ntap vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMap2 pcas na     ntap vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMapt ntap iref   vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=10
XMap3 ndp  ndp    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=10
XMap4 pcas ndp    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=10

* Aux_n : tail 100u from vdd (PMOS input). inputs nref_n (Man1) / nma (Man2).
XMna1 ndn  nref_n ndtn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=10
XMna2 ncas nma    ndtn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=10
XMnat ndtn pbi    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=10
XMna3 ndn  ndn    vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10
XMna4 ncas ndn    vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=10

*======================================================================
* Main folded-cascode amplifier. Single-ended output at vout.
*  Branch A = output branch (vinn/M1); Branch B = mirror-ref (vinp/M2).
*  Currents: tail 500u (250 each input); fold source 450u; cascode 200u.
*======================================================================
XM1  na vinn ntl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=35 nf=10
XM2  nb vinp ntl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=35 nf=10
XMt  ntl iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=20

XM3a na pbi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=360 nf=18
XM3b nb pbi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=360 nf=18

XM5a vout pcas na vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=10
XM5b nob  pcas nb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=10

XM8a vout ncas nma vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=10
XM8b nob  ncas nmb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=10

XM9a nma nmb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
XM9b nmb nmb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8

.ends folded_cascode_ota
