* folded-cascode OTA, diode-defined fold node (SKY130)
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
XB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=20
XT0 ntail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=300 nf=60
XR1 nfp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=100 nf=20
XB2 nfp nfp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=50 nf=10
* fold sources 120uA
XF1 nfo nfp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=666 nf=111
XF2 nfm nfp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=666 nf=111
* input pair: vinp on the mirror branch
XM1 nfm vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=230 nf=46
XM2 nfo vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=230 nf=46
* mirror branch: diode stack directly at the fold node (defines its level)
XD0 nfm nfm nyb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=108 nf=27
XD2 nyb nmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=108 nf=27
* output branch: pmos cascode + cascoded nmos mirror
XC1 n1x nbc nfo vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=1000 nf=200 m=4
XN1 n1x nb_m nxb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=108 nf=27
XN0 nxb nmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=108 nf=27
RB1 nbc vdd 14000
RB2 nbc vss 186000
* bias chain replicating the mirror diodes
XBP nb_m nfp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=45 nf=9
XDA nb_m nb_m nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=108 nf=27
XDB nmid nmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=108 nf=27
* stage 2
XP2 vout n1x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=994 nf=142 m=5
XN2 vout nb_s2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=1010 nf=202
XBS nb_s2 nfp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=500 nf=100
XBD nb_s2 nb_s2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=1010 nf=202
* miller
CC1 n1x voutn 1.2e-12
RR1 voutn vout 140
.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted rail-to-rail folded-cascode OTA (Sky130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C).
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* iref sinks 50 uA forced from vdd by the bench.

.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias core ----------------
XMNB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* bpt: PMOS current-source bias (220 uA branch)
XMNB1 bpt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=44 nf=2
XMPB0 bpt bpt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=260 nf=8
* bpc: top PMOS cascode gate bias (replica: q7 ~ vdd-0.2)
XMNPC bpc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=22 nf=2
XMPD1 pa bpt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=180 nf=4
XMPD2 bpc bpc pa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=15 nf=2
* bnc: bottom NMOS cascode bias (for XMN5)
XMPBC bnc bpt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=4
XMBC1 bnc bnc nblow vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
RNB nblow vss 4k
* bn5c: booster-BN stage-2 cascode bias (~1.0 V)
XMPBD bn5c bpt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=45 nf=2
XMBC3 bn5c bn5c nb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XMBC4 nb2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
* bp5c: booster-BP stage-2 cascode bias (~vdd-0.75)
XMNC3 bp5c iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMPD3 pmid pmid vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=2
RPB bp5c pmid 6k
* booster references
RVR1 iref vrefn 100k
RVR2 vrefn vss 63k
RVR3 vdd vrefp 100k
RVR4 vrefp bpt 470k

* ---------------- input pairs (220 uA tails) ----------------
XMN1 q7 vinp nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=4
XMN2 q9 vinn nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=64 nf=4
XMNT nt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=44 nf=2
XMP1 n1 vinp pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=4
XMP2 n2 vinn pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=200 nf=4
XMPT pt bpt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=260 nf=8

* ---------------- bottom folding + sinks (220 uA) ----------------
XMNS1 n1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=88 nf=4
XMNS2 n2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=88 nf=4
XMN5 d5 bnc n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=2
XMN6 vout bnout n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=2

* ---------------- top PMOS cascode mirror (220 uA branches) ---------
XMP7 q7 d5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=68 nf=4
XMP8 d5 bpc q7 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=120 nf=4
XMP9 q9 d5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=68 nf=4
XMP10 vout bpout q9 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=120 nf=4

* ---------------- booster BN (regulates n2 = vrefn via XMN6) ---------
XBB1 bd1 n2 bpt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=135 nf=4
XBB2 bd2 vrefn bpt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=135 nf=4
XBBT bpt1 bpt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=90 nf=2
XBB3 bd1 bd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=4
XBB4 bd2 bd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=48 nf=4
XBB5 bd3 bd2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=2
XBB7 bnout bn5c bd3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=2
XBB6 bnout bpt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=72 nf=2
CBN bnout bd2 0.5p

* ---------------- booster BP (regulates q9 = vrefp via XMP10) --------
XBP1 bu1 q9 bnt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=45 nf=4
XBP2 bu2 vrefp bnt1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=45 nf=4
XBPT bnt1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2
XBP3 bu1 bu1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=2
XBP4 bu2 bu1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=2
XBP5 bu3 bu2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=105 nf=4
XBP7 bpout bp5c bu3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=105 nf=4
XBP6 bpout iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
CBP bpout bu2 0.5p

.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted complementary-input folded-cascode OTA (Sky130 1.8 V devices).
* Ports: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* iref: bench forces 50 uA from vdd into iref.

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bottom-boost amplifier: PMOS input pair (senses low node bX),
* two-stage with cascoded second stage. out = -A*(vinp - vinn).
* Pins: vdd vss vinp vinn vout vbp0 vgcn vgcp
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt boost_n vdd vss vinp vinn vout vbp0 vgcn vgcp
XMt   sp_b vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=66
XMi1  d1   vinp sp_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=20
XMi2  d2   vinn sp_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=20
XMm1  d1   d1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=13
XMm2  d2   d1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=13
XMdrv dd3  d2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12
XMc3  vout vgcn dd3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12
XPl2  dd4  vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=49
XMc4  vout vgcp dd4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=49
Ccn   d2   n_z  35f
Rzn   n_z  vout 3k
* anti-starvation: dead input pair -> d2 high -> NMOS driver on -> vout low
Rst   vdd  d2   2meg
.ends boost_n


.subckt boost_ns vdd vss vinp vinn vout vbp0 vgcn vgcp
XMt   sp_b vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=66
XMi1  d1   vinp sp_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=20
XMi2  d2   vinn sp_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1   w=20
XMm1  d1   d1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=13
XMm2  d2   d1   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=13
XMdrv dd3  d2   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12
XMc3  vout vgcn dd3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12
XPl2  dd4  vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=49
XMc4  vout vgcp dd4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=49
Ccn   d2   n_z  120f
Rzn   n_z  vout 3k
Rst   vdd  d2   2meg
.ends boost_ns

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-boost amplifier: NMOS LVT input pair (senses high node aX),
* two-stage with cascoded second stage. out = -A*(vinp - vinn).
* Pins: vdd vss vinp vinn vout vbn0 vgcn vgcp2
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt boost_p vdd vss vinp vinn vout vbn0 vgcn vgcp2
XMt   sn_b vbn0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8
XMi1  d1   vinp sn_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20
XMi2  d2   vinn sn_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20
XMm1  d1   d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=42
XMm2  d2   d1   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=42
XMdrv dd3  d2   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40
XMc3  vout vgcp2 dd3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40
XNl2  dd4  vbn0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6
XMc4  vout vgcn dd4 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6
Ccp   d2   n_z  35f
Rzp   n_z  vout 3k
* anti-starvation: dead input pair -> d2 high -> PMOS driver off -> vout low
Rst   vdd  d2   2meg
.ends boost_p

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Main OTA
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* --- bias generation from iref (50 uA) ---
XNb   iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
XNbr  vbp0 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10
XPbr  vbp0 vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=82
* vgcn (~0.95 V): diode NMOS with source resistor
XNc1  vgcn vgcn ngc  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4
Rgc   ngc  vss 50k
XPc1  vgcn vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8
* vgcp (~vdd-1.2 V): diode PMOS with source resistor
XPc2  vgcp vgcp pgc  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8
Rgc2  pgc  vdd 50k
XNc3  vgcp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
* vgcp2 (~vdd-0.75 V): diode LVT PMOS with source resistor
XPc4  vgcp2 vgcp2 pgc2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8
Rgc4  pgc2 vdd 50k
XNc5  vgcp2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
XNc6  vgcn2 vgcn2 ngc2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4
Rgc6  ngc2 vss 90k
XPc6  vgcn2 vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8
XPc7  vgcp3 vgcp3 pgc3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8
Rgc7  pgc3 vdd 90k
XNc7  vgcp3 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
* reference voltages for boost regulation targets (resistor dividers)
Rrt1  vdd  vrt 20k
Rrt2  vrt  vss 180k
Rrb1  vdd  vrb 178k
Rrb2  vrb  vss 22k

* --- NMOS input pair (resistively degenerated for constant gm) ---
XMn0  tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64
XM1n  aL   vinp sn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=145
XM2n  aR   vinn sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=145
Rn1   sn1  tailn 456
Rn2   sn2  tailn 456
* --- PMOS input pair ---
XMp0  sp   vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=131
XM1p  bL   vinp sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=66
XM2p  bR   vinn sp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=66
* --- top PMOS current sources ---
XM5   aL   vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=426
XM6   aR   vbp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=426
* --- PMOS cascodes (individually boosted) ---
XM3   fL   vbpL aL  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=76
XM3b  cL   vgcp3 fL  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=76
XM4   fR   vbpR aR  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=76
XM4b  vout vgcp3 fR  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=76
* --- NMOS cascodes (individually boosted) ---
XM7   eL   vbnL bL  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16
XM7b  cL   vgcn2 eL vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16
XM8   eR   vbnR bR  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16
XM8b  vout vgcn2 eR vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=16
* --- bottom NMOS current mirror (diode via cL) ---
XM9   bL   cL   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28
XM10  bR   cL   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=28

* --- boost amplifiers (one per cascode device) ---
XBNR  vdd vss bR  vrb vbnR vbp0 vgcn vgcp  boost_n
XBNL  vdd vss bL  vrb vbnL vbp0 vgcn vgcp  boost_ns
XBPR  vdd vss aR  vrt vbpR iref vgcn vgcp2 boost_p
XBPL  vdd vss aL  vrt vbpL iref vgcn vgcp2 boost_p
* anti-latch bleeders: pre-bias cascode gates toward "on" if a booster is dead
RalR  vbpR vss 2meg
RalL  vbpL vss 2meg
RbnR  vdd vbnR 2meg
RbnL  vdd vbnL 2meg
.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted rail-to-rail input folded-cascode OTA + common-source output stage
* SKY130 1.8V core devices, ideal R/C for compensation and bias.
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ================= bias generation =================
* iref is forced to sink 50uA from vdd.  Diode-connected NMOS sets V(iref).
XB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=4

* PMOS bias voltage vbp  (vdd -> pfet diode -> vbp -> nfet sink gate=iref -> vss)
XB1 vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=4
XB2 vbp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=4

* cascode gate bias vcasn = two series nfet diodes, fed by a pfet from vdd
XB3 vcasn vcasn nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XB4 nmid nmid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XB5 vcasn vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=10 nf=2

* mirror-cascode gate bias vcxp : vdd -> pfet diode -> vcxp -> nfet sink
XB6 vcxp vcxp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=4 nf=1
XB7 vcxp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=40 nf=4

* ================= rail-to-rail input gm stage =================
* NMOS input pair (lvt, low vth -> low-CM extension)
XA1 nfa nfa tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=4
XA2 nfb nfb tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=4
* PMOS input pair
XB1p nfa nfa tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=4
XB2p nfb nfb tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=100 nf=4

* tails
XTN tailn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=24 nf=2
XTP tailp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=48 nf=2

* folding current sinks at the folding nodes
XFS1 nfa iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=2
XFS2 nfb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=16 nf=2

* NMOS cascodes up to the mirror nodes
XC1 ga1 vcasn nfa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2
XC2 ga2 vcasn nfb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=2

* PMOS mirror load, cascoded output branch
XM1 ga1 ga1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
XM2 ga2 ga1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
XM3 cx vcxp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=2
XM4 ga2 ga1 cx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=30 nf=2

* ================= common-source output stage =================
* stage-1 output node ga2 drives an NMOS CS device; PMOS current source load
XO1 vout ga2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=170 nf=4
XO2 vout vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=200 nf=4

* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
CC1 ga2 vout 2.9p
RZ1 vout ga2 250

.ends folded_cascode_ota

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted rail-to-rail folded-cascode OTA (SKY130 1.8V devices + ideal R/C)
*
* Architecture:
*   - NMOS LVT input pair (main gm at 0.9 V common mode)
*   - PMOS LVT auxiliary input pair (extends input range toward vss)
*   - Folded cascode summing with NMOS (bottom) and PMOS (top) regulated
*     cascode current mirrors; four output branches at vout.
*   - Four two-stage gain-boosting amplifiers regulate the cascode gates
*     (BN1/BN2 for NMOS cascodes, BP1/BP2 for PMOS cascodes).
*   - Bias: 50 uA into iref -> NMOS mirror (nbias = iref); legs make pbias
*     and a low-Vov sink bias nbias2.

* ---------------- two-stage inverting booster, PMOS input (for NMOS cascode)
.subckt boost_n vss vdd nbias pbias sn rf out
* stage 1: PMOS pair (sn = v+, rf = v-) with NMOS mirror load
XMB1 nb1 sn nsb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMB2 out1 rf nsb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMBT nsb pbias vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=14 nf=2

circuit:
* Gain-boosted rail-to-rail two-stage OTA, rev4.
* Architecture:
*  stage 1: complementary input pairs, input-bootstrapped LVT cascodes,
*           cascoded current-mirror summing into high-Z node sn (nl = diode side).
*  stage 2: single-ended complementary CS devices (gates at sn), LVT cascodes to vout.
*  output: gain-boosted NMOS/PMOS branches, cross-tracked bias currents.
*  bias: iref (50u NMOS master) and gpb (PMOS master) only; no CM-tracking chains.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias masters ----------------
* iref: external 50u sink; NMOS master diode ~0.62V.
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
* gpb: PMOS master diode ~vdd-0.62, sunk by a matched 50u NMOS mirror.
XMPM gpb gpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMPM_I gpb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* boost-loop references: vref_en = 0.30, vref_ep = vdd-0.30
RD1 vdd vref_ep 12k
RD2 vref_ep vref_en 48k
RD3 vref_en vss 12k

* gb_hi ~ 1.15V: two stacked NMOS diodes fed by a PMOS current source.
XSTK_I gb_hi gpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
XSTK2 gb_hi gb_hi stk1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XSTK1 stk1 stk1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1

* bias_pc ~ vdd-1.25: two stacked PMOS diodes fed by a 30u NMOS sink
* (gate of the PMOS mirror-output cascode XCCP).
XPCS1 pcs1 pcs1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XPCS2 bias_pc bias_pc pcs1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XFBN_PC bias_pc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1

* stage-2 cascode gate biases from a divider off gb_hi: nbcas~0.92, pbcas~0.50
RBV1 gb_hi nbcas 20k
RBV2 nbcas pbcas 36k
RBV3 pbcas vss 43k

* ---------------- stage 1: RRO pairs, mirror-summed into sn ----------------
* NMOS input pair + bootstrapped LVT cascodes
XM1N m1nd vinn s1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XM2N m2nd vinp s1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XIT1N s1n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=2
XLCN1 nl vinn m1nd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XLCN2 sn vinp m2nd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
* PMOS mirror load of NMOS pair, cascoded at sn
XM3P nl nl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=2
XM4P p_m nl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=2
XCCP sn bias_pc p_m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=20 nf=2
* PMOS input pair + bootstrapped LVT cascodes
XM1P m1pd vinn s1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=5
XM2P m2pd vinp s1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=5
XIT1P s1p gpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=52 nf=4
XLCPL1 pl vinn m1pd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=10
XLCPL2 sn vinp m2pd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=10
* NMOS mirror load of PMOS pair, cascoded at sn
XM3N pl pl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XM4N q_n pl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XCCN sn iref q_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=2

* ---------------- stage 2: single-ended complementary CS, gates at sn --------
XIT2N s2n iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=52 nf=4
XN2L n2ld sn s2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XLC2N vout nbcas n2ld vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=50 nf=5
XIT2P s2p gpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=8
XP2L p2ld sn s2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=150 nf=10

* NMOS branch current = Ib0 + It2p (cross-tracked), set by gnb diode
XOBNS en2 gnb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XOBNC vout bn2o en2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=10
XGNB_D gnb gnb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=2
XGNB_B0 vdd gpb gnb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=4
XGNB_TP vdd gpb gnb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=128 nf=8
* PMOS branch current = Ib0 + It2n (cross-tracked), set by gpb_b diode
XOBPS ep2 gpb_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=2
XOBPC vout bp2o ep2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=400 nf=10
XGPB_D gpb_b gpb_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=2
XGPB_B0 gpb_b iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=26 nf=2
XGPB_TN gpb_b iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=52 nf=4

* ---------------- boost amplifiers ----------------
* BN: PMOS pair, (+)=vref_en (-)=en2, NMOS mirror of (+) side; en2 up -> bn2o down.
XITBN bns gpb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
XBNP bnx vref_en bns vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XBNM bn2o en2 bns vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XBM1 bnx bnx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XBM2 bn2o bnx vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
CBN bn2o vss 0.12p
* BP: NMOS pair, (+)=vref_ep (-)=ep2, PMOS mirror of (+) side; ep2 up -> bp2o down.

XBPP bpx vref_ep bps vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XBPm bp2o ep2 bps vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XBPM1 bpx bpx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=4
XBPM2 bp2o bpx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=4
CBP bp2o vss 0.12p

* ---------------- compensation ----------------
CC1 vout cz 2.0p
RZ cz sn 160

* ---------------- anti-floating bleed resistors ----------------
RB1 m1nd vss 10meg
RB2 m2nd vss 10meg
RB3 m1pd vdd 10meg
RB4 m2pd vdd 10meg

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted rail-to-rail folded-cascode OTA, sky130 1.8V devices + ideal R/C.
*
* Architecture (crossed complementary folded cascode):
*   NMOS input pair drains at fn_a/fn_b, fed by PMOS loads (bp_m), folded to
*   vout through gain-boosted PMOS cascodes XPC (booster senses fn vs vref_p).
*   PMOS input pair drains at fp_a/fp_b, sunk by NMOS fold devices (bn_m1),
*   folded to vout through gain-boosted NMOS cascodes XNC (booster senses fp
*   vs vref_n). Signal currents of both pairs add at the output node.
*   All bias currents derive from the 50uA iref via clamped cascode-master
*   mirrors; a 1/4-scale replica column reproduces the exact device Vds so
*   the upper/lower branch currents balance (low systematic offset).
*
* Boost amplifier cells:
*   bamp_n: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load, NMOS tail (gate on vbn).
*   bamp_p: PMOS diff pair, NMOS mirror load, PMOS tail (gate on vbp).
*   out = A*(inp - inn).

.subckt bamp_n vdd vss inp inn out vbn
XN1 nd1 inp tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=23 nf=5
XN2 nd2 inn tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=23 nf=5
XP1 nd1 nd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=61 nf=13
XP2 out nd1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=61 nf=13
XNT tailn vbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=47 nf=10
Cb out vss 0.5p
.ends bamp_n

.subckt bamp_p vdd vss inp inn out vbp
XP1 nd1 inp tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=61 nf=13
XP2 nd2 inn tailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=61 nf=13
XN1 nd1 nd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=15 nf=3
XN2 out nd1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=15 nf=3
XPT tailp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=121 nf=25
Cb out vss 0.5p
.ends bamp_p

.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- main signal path ----------------
* NMOS input pair (350uA per device at balance)
XNIa fna vinp tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=175 nf=35
XNIb fnb vinn tn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=175 nf=35
XTN tn bn_m2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=348 nf=70

* PMOS input pair, low-Vt (200uA per device at balance)
XPIa fpa vinp tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=400 nf=80
XPIb fpb vinn tp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=400 nf=80
XTP tp bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=291 nf=60

* PMOS loads feeding fn nodes (450uA each), gates from clamped PMOS master
XPLa fna bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=684 nf=140
XPLb fnb bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=684 nf=140

* NMOS fold devices sinking fp nodes (300uA each), gates from clamped NMOS master
XNFa fpa bn_m1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=150 nf=30
XNFb fpb bn_m1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=150 nf=30

* gain-boosted output cascodes (100uA each at balance)
XPCa vout pcga fna vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=139 nf=28
XPCb vout pcgb fnb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=139 nf=28
XNCa vout nca fpa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=17 nf=4
XNCb vout ncb fpb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=17 nf=4

* boosters: out = A*(inp-inn); polarity gives negative feedback on fn/fp
XBPa vdd vss vref_p fna pcga bn_m1 bamp_n
XBPb vdd vss vref_p fnb pcgb bn_m1 bamp_n
XBNa vdd vss fpa vref_n nca bp_m bamp_p
XBNb vdd vss fpb vref_n ncb bp_m bamp_p

* booster compensation / bias decoupling
Cpca pcga vdd 2p
Cpcb pcgb vdd 2p
Cnca nca vss 2p
Cncb ncb vss 2p

* ---------------- master bias from iref ----------------
* iref sinks 50uA; diode gives NMOS master gate
XMnr bn_m0 bn_m0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* PMOS master: device clamped to |Vds|=0.18 by amp XAp1 (sourced vs vref_p)
XMpd pm_d bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=76 nf=16
XNn1 pm_d bn_m0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XAp1 vdd vss vref_p pm_d bp_m bn_m1 bamp_n
* NMOS master #1: device clamped to Vds=0.18 by amp XAn1 -> bn_m1 (fold, misc)
XPn1 nm_d1 bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=76 nf=16
XMnd1 nm_d1 bn_m1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=25 nf=5
XAn1 vdd vss nm_d1 vref_n bn_m1 bp_m bamp_p
* NMOS master #2: device clamped to Vds=0.35 by amp XAn2 -> bn_m2 (tails)
XPn2 nm_d2 bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=76 nf=16
XMnd2 nm_d2 bn_m2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=25 nf=5
XAn2 vdd vss nm_d2 vref_tn bn_m2 bp_m bamp_p

* voltage references from mirrored 30uA through ideal resistors
* vref_p = vdd - 0.18 ; vref_n = 0.18 ; vref_tn = 0.35 ; vcm ~ 0.9
Rvrefp vdd vref_p 6k
XNrp vref_p bn_m1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=23 nf=5
XPcs1 vref_n bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=61 nf=13
Rvrefn vref_n vss 6k
XPcs2 vref_tn bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=61 nf=13
Rvreft vref_tn vss 11.7k
XPcs3 vc2 bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=61 nf=13
XMdv vc2 vc2 vc1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=7.5 nf=10
Rvcm vc1 vss 11.7k

* ---------------- quarter-scale replica column ----------------
* same devices/biases as one side; fold nodes clamped by amps -> pcg_r/ncg_r.
* currents: load 112.5u, pair-n 87.5u, pc 25u, nc 25u, pair-p 50u, fold 75u.
XPLr fnr bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=76 nf=16
XPCr voutr pcgr fnr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=139 nf=28
XNCr voutr ncgr fpr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=17 nf=4
XNFr fpr bn_m1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=18.75 nf=4
XNIr fnr vcm tnr vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=43.75 nf=9
XTNr tnr bn_m2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=87.5 nf=18
XPIr fpr vcm tpr vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=100 nf=20
XTPr tpr bp_m vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=36.4 nf=8
XAr vdd vss vref_p fnr pcgr bn_m1 bamp_n

* bias node decoupling
Cbm0 bn_m0 vss 1p

taskTitle: Design a Gain-Boosted Folded-Cascode OTA: Gain 130 dB, UGB 200 MHz, PM 60 deg, Noise 50 uVrms
circuit:
* Gain-boosted complementary-input folded-cascode OTA, two stages, SKY130 continuous models.
* Stage 1: folded cascode. NMOS main pair (std nfet) folds down through L=1 nfet cascodes;
*          PMOS auxiliary pair (pfet_lvt) folds up through pfet_lvt cascodes.
*          The PMOS cascode is gain-boosted (local CS amp + source follower).
*          Inverting stage-1 output x2 drives stage 2.
* Stage 2: cascoded CS (nfet_lvt driver + nfet_lvt cascode below; pfet_lvt load +
*          pfet_lvt cascode above, gain-boosted). Miller Cc + Rz compensation.
* All biasing from the single external iref (bench forces 50 uA from vdd into iref).
*
* Terminal order: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
.subckt folded_cascode_ota vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

****************************** bias master chain ******************************
* iref sinks 50 uA: NMOS diode master; iref node is the 50u NMOS gate bias.
XMNm0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
* PMOS master diode (pfet_lvt) at 50 uA: pbm = vdd - |Vgs_plvt(50u, w=10)|.
XMPm pbm pbm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1
XMNmm pbm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1

* NMOS tail bias nbt ~ 1.15 V: diode Vgs(25u, w=5) + 16k*25u = 0.4 V.
XMPbnbt nbt pbm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=5 nf=1
XMNdnbt nbt1 nbt1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
Rnbt nbt1 nbt 16k
* NMOS fold-sink bias nbf = Vgs(25u in w=2.5).
XMPbnbf nbf pbm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=5 nf=1
XMNdnbf nbf nbf vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
* PMOS pair-tail bias pbt = vdd - 0.6 (diode) - 0.6 (24k*25u).
XMNbpbt pbt iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.75 nf=1
Rpbt vdd pbt1 24k
XMPdpbt pbt pbt pbt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12 nf=1
* PMOS fold-source bias pbf = vdd - |Vgs_pfet(25u in w=3.85, l=0.3)| ~ vdd - 1.15.
XMNbpbf pbf iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.75 nf=1
XMPdpbf pbf pbf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=3.85 nf=1
* Stage-2 PMOS load gate pbq = vdd - |Vgs_plvt(50u in w=20)| ~ vdd - 0.6.
XMNbpbq pbq iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XMPdpbq pbq pbq vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=1
* Stage-2 NMOS mirror bias nbq = Vgs_nlvt(50u in w=23.3) ~ 0.62.
XMPbnbq nbq pbm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1
XMNdnbq nbq nbq vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=23.3 nf=1

********************* stage 1: complementary folded cascode *******************
* PMOS auxiliary input pair (pfet_lvt) + low-dropout tail (200u).
XMPt nt1 pbt vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=240 nf=1
XMP1 f1 vinn nt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40 nf=1
XMP2 f2 vinp nt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40 nf=1
* NMOS main input pair (std nfet) + tail (350u).
XMNt nb1 nbt vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=1
XMN1 h1 vinn nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
XMN2 h2 vinp nb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=1
* Fold sinks (250u) at f1/f2 and fold sources (325u) at h1/h2.
XMNs1 f1 nbf vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=1
XMNs2 f2 nbf vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=1
XMPs1 h1 pbf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=65 nf=1
XMPs2 h2 pbf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=65 nf=1
* Cascodes; x1 = internal, x2 = inverting output node driving stage 2.
XMNc1 x1 nbc f1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMNc2 x2 nbc f2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=1
XMPc1 x1 pbc h1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=60 nf=1
XMPc2 x2 pbc h2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=60 nf=1

* NMOS cascode-gate replica: 15u source into nbc; diode (l=1,w=1.5) onto
* fref = 15u x 33.3k = 0.5 V. nbc = 0.5 + Vgs => f nodes sit ~0.5 V.
XMPbnbc nbc pbm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=3 nf=1
XMNdcbc nbc nbc fref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
Rfre fref vss 33.3k
* PMOS cascode-gate boost amp 1: senses h2, drains into ab1, follower drives pbc.
Rpbup pbm pbc 100k
XMNb1 ab1 h2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMPlb1 ab1 pbf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 nf=1
XMNf1 vdd ab1 pbc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XMNfs1 pbc nbq vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=14 nf=1

*********************** stage 2: cascoded CS output stage *********************
XMNout sn2 x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=280 nf=1
XMNcasc vout nb2f sn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=280 nf=1
XMload hr2 pbq vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=240 nf=1
XMloadc vout pb2f hr2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=240 nf=1

* NMOS cascode-gate replica: va = Vgs_nlvt(50u, w=23.3); vb = va + Vgs; Rnb
* drops ~0.45 V so nb2f = vb - 0.45 ~ 0.79.
XMPbva vb pbq vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1
XMNva va va vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=23.3 nf=1
XMNvb vb vb va vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=23.3 nf=1
Rnb1 vb nb2f 34k
Rnb2 nb2f vss 79k
* PMOS cascode-gate boost amp 2: senses hr2 through source degeneration Rs2,
* drains into ab2, follower drives pb2f.
XMNb2 ab2 hr2 s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
Rs2 s2 vss 5.3k
XMPlb2 ab2 pbf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4 nf=1
XMNf2 vdd ab2 pb2f vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMNfs2 pb2f nbq vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=47 nf=1

******************************* compensation **********************************
Rz x2 vcz 120
Cc vcz vout 1.25p

*********************** float breakers + op-point hints **********************
Rx1 x1 vss 500k
Rx2 x2 vss 500k
.nodeset v(nb1)=0.55 v(h1)=0.9 v(h2)=0.9 v(nt1)=1.35 v(f1)=0.55 v(f2)=0.55
.nodeset v(x1)=0.7 v(x2)=0.7 v(pbc)=0.35 v(ab1)=1.0 v(pb2f)=0.85 v(ab2)=1.55
.nodeset v(sn2)=0.15 v(hr2)=1.25 v(s2)=0.5 v(vcz)=0.85

.ends folded_cascode_ota
